name: Newfoundland and Labrador

population.source: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population, Census Profile (98-401-X2021008)

sources.name: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population, Census Profile (98-401-X2021008)

religion_note: Statistics Canada 2021 religion question (asked once a decade), 25% sample data for the population in private households; shown at the denominations StatCan publishes, with 'No religion and secular perspectives' as its own category.
ethnicity_note: Statistics Canada publishes 'visible minority', a category of the Employment Equity Act, beside a separate multi-response ethnic or cultural origin question; neither is an ethnicity question as other countries ask one. This is the visible-minority classification, with 'Not a visible minority' kept as its own category.
language_note: Mother tongue, 2021 Census, total population excluding institutional residents (100% data), at the individual languages StatCan publishes; people who reported more than one are in the multiple-response categories rather than counted twice.
